_comment: Where each animated explainer is injected. Keyed by output page slug. 'afterSection' is the GitHub anchor slug of the H2 section the figure is appended to; the markdown is never edited. If afterSection does not match a real section the build fails loudly rather than silently dropping the animation.

05-consistent-hashing.title: Try it: how many keys actually move?
05-consistent-hashing.caption: Add and remove servers and watch the share of keys that get remapped. Switch between plain hash(key) % N and the hash ring to see the difference the chapter is describing.

04-rate-limiter.title: Try it: the five algorithms on one traffic stream
04-rate-limiter.caption: Every panel sees exactly the same requests. Send a steady trickle, then a burst, then a burst that straddles a window boundary, and watch where each algorithm accepts and where it rejects.
